missing_row_note: fwb-signature-dialog.js $onInit (edit): when main_class_list has fewer rows than main_order, each absent main class is pushed as main_class_default[id] with action='alert', severity='High', status='disable', fpm-status='disable' (block-period 600, trigger ''), then sorted by main_order. A policy created over REST has no rows (lab-sr-01..06 on fortiweb19: sz_main_class_list 0) and FortiWeb still draws the ten classes. Creating a row: POST cmdb/waf/signature/main_class_list?mkey=<policy> with main_class_id in the body (measured 2026-11-01, fortiweb19 7.6.8 build1128: 200, the row id is the main_class_id).
